source.maker: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division

methods.crossing: The first year a country's total fertility rate is below 2.1 in the UN's estimates (to 2023) or its medium projection (2024 to 2100). Countries of a million people or more in 2023.
methods.share: The share of the world's people living in a country whose total fertility rate that year is below 2.1, weighting each country by its population.
methods.floor: Countries of a million people or more whose fertility fell below 1.5 by 2023, and their path from that year on.
methods.intervals: The UN's probabilistic projections: the range within which the UN puts 80 and 95 per cent of its simulated futures, 2024 to 2100.
